title: RFCs

Request for Comments

RFCs are for significant technical decisions that benefit from broader input before being finalized.

Workflow

Draft → In Review → Final
                 ↘ Withdrawn

JWT Token Rotation Strategy

When to Write an RFC

Write an RFC when:

  • The change affects more than one service

  • The design has non-obvious trade-offs

  • You want async feedback before implementation

  • The change is irreversible (data model, protocol changes)
